lead: Gritty cinematic film still, early 1990s America, muted khaki and grey, deep crimson accents.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Skullhead.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen Skullhead-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish Skullhead-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line, kept free of gore; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: man
images.prompt: A lonely young man sitting on the curb of an empty parking lot at night, head in his hands.

images.name: contract
images.prompt: An old parchment contract on a dark table beside a candle, a red signature at the bottom.

images.name: town
images.prompt: A small American town main street at dusk with a diner, a mall sign and a water tower.

images.name: stage
images.prompt: A long empty 1990s office corridor lined with cubicles under flickering fluorescent lights.

images.name: place
images.prompt: An empty mid-sized shopping mall at night, escalators and closed storefronts.

images.name: journal
images.prompt: An old leather journal lying open on a desk beside a red pen and a desk lamp.

images.name: flow
images.prompt: A worn armchair in a dark motel room, a chainsaw leaning against the wall beside it.

images.name: ragdoll
images.prompt: A small jointed wooden artist's mannequin on an office desk, one of its arms snapped off and lying beside it.

images.name: devil
images.prompt: A red-lit silhouette with horns standing at the end of a dark hallway.

images.name: props
images.prompt: Smashed office desks, a toppled copy machine and scattered paper in a wrecked office.
